viewing_area: Chennai Port Trust VIP Gallery — Zone B
purpose: The International Coast Guard Fleet Review is a ceremonial display of maritime unity, where coast guard vessels from participating nations assemble in formation to be reviewed by the supreme reviewing authority — a tradition that symbolises international solidarity on the high seas.
importance: ICGFR 2027 carries special significance as it coincides with the Golden Jubilee of the Indian Coast Guard and marks the largest fleet review ever conducted in the Indian Ocean Region, with 57 nations and 48 vessels participating.

indian_fleet.label: Indian Coast Guard Fleet
indian_fleet.description: Six Indian Coast Guard vessels form the central column, led by the reviewing vessel ICGS Samudra Paheredar at the apex of the formation.

international_fleet.label: International Fleet
international_fleet.description: 42 international vessels arranged in two flanking columns, steaming in order of arrival with national ensigns at the masthead and coloured bunting from bow to stern.

route_map.title: Fleet Review Route & Viewing Areas
route_map.description: The reviewing vessel proceeds along the designated route from Chennai Port Trust Wharf through the review anchorage, passing all 48 vessels in formation.

safety_guidelines.title: Carry Delegate Pass
safety_guidelines.description: Your Fleet Review viewing pass and summit delegate credentials are mandatory for entry to all restricted viewing areas.

safety_guidelines.title: Arrive 30 Minutes Early
safety_guidelines.description: Report to your designated gate at least 30 minutes before the scheduled reporting time to complete security screening.

safety_guidelines.title: Follow Security Instructions
safety_guidelines.description: Comply with all instructions from coast guard security personnel and port authority officials at all times.

safety_guidelines.title: Photography Guidelines
safety_guidelines.description: Personal photography is permitted. Professional media equipment requires separate press accreditation.

safety_guidelines.title: Restricted Areas
safety_guidelines.description: Do not enter marked restricted zones on the wharf or aboard vessels without explicit authorisation.

safety_guidelines.title: Emergency Assembly Point
safety_guidelines.description: In case of emergency, proceed immediately to Assembly Point Alpha near Gate 3 — follow coast guard personnel directions.

faqs.question: What time should delegates report?
faqs.answer: Delegates assigned to VIP Gallery Zone B should report at Gate 3 by 07:30 IST. Shuttle departures from ITC Grand Chola begin at 06:00 IST.

faqs.question: Can cameras be carried?
faqs.answer: Personal cameras and smartphones are permitted. Professional camera equipment, drones, and tripods require separate media accreditation from the Fleet Review Secretariat.

faqs.question: Where is the viewing area?
faqs.answer: Your assigned viewing area is VIP Gallery Zone B at Chennai Port Trust. Seat B-142 is on the port side with unobstructed views of the fleet formation.

faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: Formal uniform for military and coast guard delegates; business attire for civilian delegates. Traditional dress is welcome. Comfortable footwear is recommended.

faqs.question: How do I reach the venue?
faqs.answer: Complimentary shuttle buses operate from ITC Grand Chola from 06:00 IST. Your assigned pickup is at 06:45 IST at the Main Portico. Alternatively, taxis may drop at Gate 3.

faqs.question: What happens if weather conditions change?
faqs.answer: The Fleet Review will proceed in Sea State 3 or below. Updates will be sent via the delegate portal and SMS. Indoor viewing arrangements are available as contingency.
